prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one extraordinarily polished high-fidelity iPhone app SCREEN, flat straight-on screen design, portrait approximately 1170 x 2532. This is a visual concept for a private digital wardrobe and personal stylist for Muslim women, first used by a wife with a mixed Western and Pakistani wardrobe. It builds modest outfits ONLY from owned clothes. Clean minimal native iOS design, real large readable UI type, generous yet useful space, accessible dark text. Native status bar at top with 9:41, dark camera island, native safe areas, familiar bottom tab bar with four labeled SF-symbol-like icons Today / Closet / Looks / Stylist, home indicator. Avoid a phone hardware mockup, angled device, poster, marketing landing page, decorative flowers, Islamic ornament, sparkles, gradients, random cards, invented product name or logo, shopping, prices, sale labels, badges, performance claims, watermarks or attribution. Use high-quality photoreal clothing cutouts, fabric details and soft natural contact shadows, not drawings. Common owned outfit in every version: full-length flowing mushroom-taupe open abaya, opaque long ivory tunic, cream wide-leg trousers, dusty mauve hijab, dark chocolate flat shoes. No humans or bodies. Primary task is making today's outfit from these existing pieces. Small trustworthy supporting copy. Earth colors with very restrained flower pink, purple and white. This is a usable operational app screen, not an art poster. Direction A, The dressing room. Warm flower-white background #FAF8F3, ink #322E28, pale sand stage #EEE8DE, deep muted plum primary #675469, sage small accent. A personal fitting table translated into an app. Top row small text "Your wardrobe, reimagined" and a quiet circular profile button. Editorial serif large heading on two lines "A little inspiration\nfor today." then standard system UI text "Start with the pieces you love." Three native compact segmented occasion choices "Work", "Everyday", "Occasion", Work selected. ONE large beautiful unboxed flatlay composition filling the middle 46 percent of the screen: arranged matching 5 garments with thoughtful scale and clear separation, taupe abaya tall left, ivory tunic upper right, cream trousers lower middle, mauve hijab right, chocolate flats bottom right. Below composition title "Soft layers, busy days" and smaller "5 pieces from your closet". Subtle small horizontal row "Long sleeves  ·  Full length  ·  Hijab". Two clear controls: a generous full-width muted plum filled button "Style me" and below outlined quieter "Build my own". Tiny secondary text action "Use a reference photo". Tab Today active in muted plum. Fine editorial typography only in large heading, all controls system sans. Layout must fit, with bottom bar in safe area.
approvalScope: Background and overall visual identity. Original Today controls are superseded by the daily-default requirement.
